thesis: PLMR is a high-quality, accelerating compounder in a clean uptrend: revenue is up 58% YoY, net income growth has stepped up quarter by quarter, and the stock broke out to a 52-week high on double average volume after a post-earnings gap that held. Valuation looks reasonable for the growth (forward P/E 14.0), free cash flow is strong and dilution risk is low. The setup is only attractive on a pullback to the 159.5-162.5 zone, not at the extended close. The risk-off regime (VIX extremes, QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages) is a real headwind, so this is a conditional, modest-conviction long, and a gap higher without a pullback should be skipped.
